_about: Built by tool/catalog_update.py from Microsoft Learn release information and the MSRC security update API. Version entries are never deleted; monthly entries are kept for the last 12 released cycles. kb_builds lists every KB of a month with the builds it applies to; servicing_siblings lists versions that share a KB (one servicing line, same revision numbers). Edit feature_target by hand.

companions.KB5129195: Sep 14 out-of-band fix (RDS, Hyper-V shares, USB audio)

feature_comparison_policy: Windows 10 22H2 and catalogued Windows 11 general releases are eligible for same-period feature impact comparisons. LTSC and releases sold only on new devices are excluded. This is dashboard comparison policy, not Microsoft upgrade or hardware eligibility.
